title: Bring elv to current public API parity and improve agent workflows
description: Original goal remains broad: latest public REST and realtime API capability, usable discovery/workflows, maintainability and performance. Current audit found 24 newly published operations including Flows image/video/speech and Assets, plus triage tickets. Verify positive request/response behavior, safety, docs, full gate and installed runtime; do not infer parity from counts alone.
